steps.step: CREATE: 2 real VECTOR nodes (closed path w/ hole, open path), rotation, fill, stroke
READ: triangle node is a real VECTOR with vectorPaths, correct fill/stroke/rotation read back
READ: open zigzag path is a real VECTOR, no fill (stroke-only), vectorPaths present
TRANSFORM: resize + reposition a vector node lands correctly
MEASURE: real bounds for both vector nodes
DIFF: detects a deliberate mismatch on a vector node's geometry
VERIFY: matches the post-transform vector state
RECONCILE: re-applying the identical vector doc in sync mode updates existing nodes, creates none
post-reconcile read: vector node still exists with valid geometry (sync correctly re-applied the authored width, a real and expected sync-mode behavior, not corruption)
cleanup: vector composition deleted and confirmed absent
